children: Burford Capital announced a planned $300 million senior secured notes offering and a conditional redemption of its $400 million 2028 notes.
Issuer to privately offer $300M aggregate principal amount of senior secured notes due 2029 by Burford Capital Global Finance LLC.
Issuer delivered conditional notice to redeem all $400M of outstanding 6.250% senior notes due 2028 on Sept 24, 2026, subject to receiving ≥ $300M of indebtedness proceeds.
Redemption contingent on proceeds from debt incurrences (including the planned offering) on terms satisfactory to the Issuer.
Burford intends additional de-leveraging after redemption, which may include opportunistic open-market purchases of outstanding debt.
